g.title: caller
g.text: any phone · speaks any of 9 Indian languages

g.title: twilio
g.text: phone number · turns call into SIP

g.title: livekit
g.text: real-time audio room support-room · SIP bridge

g.title: vad
g.text: Silero VAD, 0.5 s stop · detects end of turn

g.title: stt
g.text: speech to text · labels every sentence with its language

g.title: router
g.text: greets in Hindi + English · follows the caller's language
switches the TTS voice · adds a reply-language note (3+ words to switch)

g.title: llm
g.text: low reasoning effort · replies in the caller's language and script
searches with an English query + the caller's own words

g.title: weaviate
g.text: hybrid: bge-m3 vector + BM25 on English keywords, alpha 0.6
check_* tools fetch a section by filter
